ONCOR and LCRA TSC Bell County East to Big Hill 765 kV Transmission Project

V8 LANDOWNERS COALITION (PARTY NO. 771) OBJECTION TO ONCOR ELECTRIC
DELIVERY COMPANY LLC AND LCRA TRANSMISSION SERVICES CORPORATION'S
OBJECTIONS TO CERTAIN INTERVENORS' EXHIBITS LISTED IN ATTACHMENT A OF
SOAH ORDER NO. 30

Pro se Intervenors V8 Landowners Coalition (Party No. 771) respectfully urge the Court to deny
Applicants’ objection to Exhibit 1.

1. Applicants’ Basis for Objectionable Exhibits Ex. Nos. 1-10, 1-A, 2A, 2B, 2C, 2E, 2F, 2G, 2H,
21, 2J, 14, AND 15: “The V8 Landowners Coalition has not filed a comprehensive exhibit list. As
shown in SOAH Order No. 30, there are multiple materials identified as “Ex.1” for the party.

On June 7, 2026, at 9:15 p.m., Suzzette McBee uploaded an Exhibit List identifying the
previously timely-filed Exhibit 1. This was done after reviewing the email from Kirk Rasmussen.

As Intervenors, we are simply relocating our previously filed and accepted testimony—ltem
4485 (Direct Testimony), Item 5850 (Supplemental Testimony), and the landowner
testimonies—from the Interchange into a single exhibit. We did not realize a separate Exhibit
List was required.

2. During the June 5, 2026, hearing, Applicants did not object to any of the exhibits pre-filed on
the Court's SOAH Order 30 Exhibit A, subject to the opportunity to object to the late-filed
exhibits not previously included in Exhibit A or not filed in the egnyte portal. Intervenors’ Exhibit
1 was timely filed in all three portals and was included in the Court's Order; therefore,
Applicants’ objection is untimely.

3. Applicants filed their objections after the Court Order time limit of June 7, 2026, 12 noon;
therefore, Applicants’ objections are untimely.

NOTE: Intervenors are pro se, did not submit a list of witnesses to cross-examine, and are not
on any witness list.

For the reasons stated above, Intervenors respectfully urge the Court to deny Applicants’
objection(s) to Exhibit 1, #771 and allow Intervenor’s testimony to stand as previously admitted.

 Respectfully submitted,

Suzzette McBee Deanna Barley
